members.title: Members and roles
members.intro: Invite members, grant or revoke roles, and deactivate members. Every change is kept in the history. Roles never give approval authority; that comes from the DOA.
members.forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, ask your organization admin.
members.invited: An invitation was sent to {email}. The link works for 72 hours.
members.importIntro: Download the template, fill it in from row 3 as the Guide sheet explains, then import it. If any row is wrong, nothing is saved and every row to fix is listed.
members.imported: {count, plural, one {# member was imported} other {# members were imported}} and every invitation e-mail was sent.
members.importErrors: Nothing was saved. Fix these rows and import again.
members.deactivateHint: Signs them out on every device and cancels their invitation links at once. Their history and documents stay.
members.deactivateConfirm: I confirm I want to deactivate this member
members.resetHint: The member is signed out on every device at once and sets up the authenticator app again at their next sign-in.

importReasons.UNKNOWN_ROLE: Unknown role. Use a role code or name from the Guide sheet of the template; separate several roles with commas.
importReasons.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: Same as another row in the file
importReasons.EMPLOYEE_CODE_TAKEN: This employee code is already used
importReasons.NO_ROWS: The file has no data from row 3
importReasons.TOO_MANY_ROWS: More than 500 rows; split the file and import one part at a time
importReasons.UNREADABLE: The file cannot be read; use the template from the download button
importReasons.MISSING_HEADER: Row 1 must hold the column codes of the template. Do not delete or change it: download the template again and paste your data into it.

errors.LAST_ORG_ADMIN: The organization needs at least one admin. Add a new admin first.
errors.ALREADY_GRANTED: The member already has this role.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This e-mail is already a member.
errors.SELF: You cannot do this to your own account. Ask another admin.
errors.SHARED_IDENTITY: This account is also used for another organization and cannot be reset here. Contact the BCS team.
errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.INPUT: Some fields are missing or wrong. Check them and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.FAILED: This could not be saved. Try again.
errors.EMAIL: Enter a valid e-mail, for example name@company.co.th.
errors.NAME: Enter the display name (Thai).
errors.NOT_FOUND: This member is not in the organization. Reload the page and try again.
errors.STATE: The member's status has changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.BUSY: Another change to this member is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.FILE_MISSING: Choose the filled-in Excel file first.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 900 KB. Split it and import one part at a time.
errors.ROLE_NOT_HELD: The member no longer has this role. Reload the page to see the current roles.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then do this again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it keeps happening, give this reference to the BCS team.
errors.LAST_DOA_ADMIN: The DOA separates its administrators, so it needs at least one DOA administrator. Give the role to someone else first.
errors.ADMIN_ROLES_COMBINED: The DOA separates its administrators from the organization administrators; nobody can hold both roles.

members.rolesHint: Roles decide the menus and work a member can do. They never give approval authority; that comes from the DOA.
members.noRolesHeld: No roles yet. The member works as a requester.
members.resendHint: The old link stops working at once and a new link, valid for 72 hours, is sent.
members.resetDone: Two-step verification was reset. The member was signed out on every device and will be told.
members.deactivatedNotice: Member deactivated. They can no longer sign in; their history and documents stay.
members.invitedNotSent: The invitation for {email} was saved, but the e-mail could not be sent. Choose Send a new invitation by e-mail on this member's page to send it again.
members.invitedAlready: The invitation for {email} was already saved by an earlier click. No second e-mail was sent.
members.importedNotSent: {count, plural, one {# member was imported} other {# members were imported}}; {sent} of the invitation e-mails were sent. Not sent yet: {emails}. Open these members' pages and choose Send a new invitation by e-mail.
members.importedAlready: This file was already imported ({count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}). Nothing changed and no e-mail was sent again.
members.revokeSelfConfirm: I understand that once I remove my own {role} role, only another organization admin can give it back
members.resetConfirm: I understand the member is signed out on every device and must set up the authenticator app again

template.line1: Fill in the Members sheet from row 3, one member per row.
template.line2: Do not delete or change row 1 (column codes): the import finds the columns by it. Row 2 describes the columns.
template.line3: Roles column: a role code or name from the table below; separate several roles with commas. Leave it empty for a requester.
template.line4: If any row is wrong, nothing is saved and every row to fix is listed.
template.rolesColumn: Roles (code or name, separated by commas; see the Guide sheet)

modules.title: Enabled modules
modules.intro: Modules are switched on and off by the BCS team according to your contract. This page shows their state, and the organization admins will be told every time one changes.
modules.forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, ask your organization admin.

ai.title: AI assistants
ai.intro: Switch each AI assistant on or off; it takes effect for new calls at once. Everything else works when they are off, and a person always confirms what the AI fills in.
ai.forbidden: This page is for the organization admin and the auditor. To see or change the AI settings, contact your organization admin.
ai.moduleOff: The AI module is not switched on for your organization yet. You may set things up now; the assistants start working when the BCS team switches the module on under the contract.
ai.creditsNote: {monthly} credits arrive at the start of each month, and the admins are told at {alert}%. Ask the BCS team for more.
ai.confidenceHint: Fields the AI is less sure of are confirmed one by one; amounts, quantities and tax ids always are
ai.switchedOff: {name} switched off; its drafts can still be confirmed or changed

errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this setting before you. Reload the page and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not change the AI settings
errors.NO_CHANGE: This is set already; nothing changed
errors.INTERNAL: Not saved. Tell your administrator the reference {requestId}

DOCUMENT.name: Document reader
DOCUMENT.description: Reads quotations, delivery notes and invoices and fills the form for a person to check and confirm

INTAKE.name: Request helper
INTAKE.description: Picks the request type and drafts the request from what the requester wrote or attached; the requester confirms before sending

APPROVAL_BRIEF.name: AI summary for approvers
APPROVAL_BRIEF.description: A short summary on the approval task; every number comes from the system and it never advises a decision

INSIGHT.name: Ask BCS AI
INSIGHT.description: Answers questions about procurement data in Thai, only from what the asking person may see

DOA_DRAFTER.name: DOA draft from a regulation
DOA_DRAFTER.description: Drafts approval rules from a regulation document for the admin to check one by one

SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING.name: Supplier Onboarding
SUPPLIER_ONBOARDING.description: Reads the company certificate and VAT registration a supplier uploads with its application and fills them in for the supplier or procurement to check field by field; never reads an account number, verifies a document or approves a supplier

SOURCING.name: Sourcing
SOURCING.description: Drafts an RFx's title, description and English line descriptions for procurement to check field by field, and after the close summarizes the bids and points to negotiate from figures the system calculated; never scores, awards or messages a supplier

ai.readOnly: You can read this page only. Switching assistants and changing their notebook is for the organization admin.
ai.agentNeverSaved: Never set: this assistant is off

results.title: Results of {month}
results.intro: Every number is counted from the assistants' record of work and the documents' history. Select a number to see the list.
results.fields: AI filled {filled} fields in {documents} documents people confirmed
results.checks: The system found something to check in {count} documents the AI read
results.checksDecided: People checked and decided {count} of them
results.found: The system found invoices asking {amount} baht over their PO, on {count} invoices
results.foundNote: Counts prices above the PO and quantities over what was ordered, as each invoice's latest check this month raised them, before payment
results.foundNone: This month the system found no invoice asking more than its PO
results.foundTitle: Invoices asking more than their PO this month

notebook.title: The assistants' notebook
notebook.intro: What the assistants learned from work people in the organization confirmed, with where it came from. Learned by the system's rules, not by AI.
notebook.privacy: The assistants use your organization's data in this system only. Nothing is sent to train an AI model, and no model is tuned with your data.
notebook.source: Learned from {uses} confirmations by finance out of {lines} lines of this supplier in this category over the last {days} days; last used on an invoice dated {date}
notebook.offNote: The assistant does not offer this code; the coding screen offers the budget line's code instead
notebook.forgetTitle: Delete what the assistant learned about the account code of {supplier}?
notebook.forgetText: The assistant forgets the codes confirmed so far for this supplier in this category and offers the budget line's code instead. This cannot be undone. When finance confirms a code on the next invoice, the assistant starts learning again from it. To stop it offering a code at all, switch it off instead.
notebook.disabled: Switched off the account code of {supplier}. The assistant will not offer it until it is switched on again.
notebook.enabled: The account code of {supplier} is in use again.
notebook.forgotten: Deleted what the assistant learned about the account code of {supplier}. The assistant will not use it again.
notebook.empty: The assistants have not learned anything yet. When finance confirms account codes on invoices, the assistant remembers the code used for each supplier here.
notebook.payOff: The organization does not use invoices and payment runs yet. The assistant starts learning account codes when that module is on.

errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: Someone changed this before you. Reload the page and try again.
errors.NOT_LEARNED: There is nothing left to change here. Reload the page to see the notebook as it is.
errors.NO_CHANGE: It is already set this way; nothing changed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the organization admin changes the assistants' notebook.
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: The organization switched invoices and payment runs off, so this cannot change.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The supplier of this entry was not found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Not saved. Tell the system administrator, with reference {requestId}.

changes.title: History of the settings
changes.intro: Every time someone switched an assistant on or off or changed its lowest confidence, the newest first
changes.empty: Nobody has changed the assistants' settings yet. The organization admin switches assistants on under "Each assistant".

activity.title: History of the work
activity.intro: Every time an assistant worked, the newest first. The documents, the questions and the AI's answers are not shown.
activity.empty: No work of the assistants yet. When people have the AI read a document, draft a request or answer a question, it is recorded here.
activity.checksWARN: The system asked for a check
activity.checksFAIL: The system found values that do not match
activity.notHelpful: The user found it not helpful

purposes.BRIEF: Summarized a task for the approver
purposes.QUESTION: Answered a question
purposes.DOA_DRAFT: Drafted a DOA from the rules
